DAILY-TASK [HIGH] 2026-08-22 #1 — Apply SLEEP-RUNBOOK Option A. WHAT: laptop hibernates unattended; 6h42m hole last night, 3 holes / 2.2d in the last 48h, ~59-71% of calendar time asleep. WHY: Kernel-Power 42 Reason=4 at 21:33:25 landed 6s after the watchdog's "RESTART FAILED", proving sleep not crash; Kernel-Power 187 x12 in 8 days; STANDBYIDLE already 0 on AC and DC and no scheduled task calls suspend, so every settings-based lever is already exhausted. HOW: elevated `powercfg /requestsoverride PROCESS node.exe SYSTEM`, then VERIFY with `powercfg /requests` (must list node.exe under SYSTEM) — the verify step is load-bearing because /requestsoverride is documented both as granting and as ignoring a power request, so applying it blind proves nothing. Confirm with `node tasks/doctor.cjs` showing zero holes over a subsequent 48h window. BLOCKED: needs elevation — user action. IMPACT: recovers ~15% of calendar time and puts both open positions back under supervision (they are broker-SL protected but unmanaged while down). EFFORT: Simple (<30min).

DAILY-TASK [HIGH] 2026-08-22 #2 — Make the RSI ceiling falsifiable. WHAT: 22 of 22 near-misses across 08-21 and 08-22 are RSI_ABOVE_CEILING, and no harness can sweep it, so the single binding constraint on trade count is unfalsifiable. WHY (verified today, not recalled): MOMENTUM_RSI_MAX=72 at server/index.js:1147 and TREND_FOLLOW_RSI_MAX=68 at :1149 are function-local consts, not config; tasks/_replay_mtf.cjs plumbs only MTF_MIN_ENTRY_RSI (line 137); tasks/rsi_walkforward.cjs sweeps only the floor (line 54, replay(symbol, ticker, minEntryRsi)). Today's smallest margin is Gold D1 MOMENTUM at RSI 80.8 vs ceiling 72. HOW: lift both consts to env overrides (MTF_MOMENTUM_RSI_MAX / MTF_TREND_FOLLOW_RSI_MAX) alongside the existing floor plumbing, then add a ceiling variant of rsi_walkforward.cjs and score on WORST FOLD, not mean. IMPACT: unknown by construction — that is the point; it converts the top blocker from opinion to measurement. Do NOT move the ceiling before the sweep exists. EFFORT: Medium (30-90min). NOTE: touches signal generation, so per CLAUDE.md the scaffold + explicit approval is required before the first line of code.
